description: What the dispatcher records about a job beside its parameters. `completedUnits` and `unitCursors` appear once a worker has checkpointed. `retryCount` counts the times the queue has put the job back to pending after a failure it classes as transient.

id.description: The job's id: `job-` followed by a version 4 UUID written as 32 lowercase hex digits, without dashes.

userId.description: The DID of the principal whose `job:create` created the job.

created.description: When the job was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

maxRetries.description: How many transient failures the queue retries: 0 for generation, whose re-run produces different content; 1 for every other type.

completedUnits.description: The units a worker has finished, merged across checkpoints and failures as a set.

unitCursors.description: How far each unfinished unit got, keyed by unit.
